directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay commenting on the importance of building trust between business and consumers.You can cite examples to illustrate your views. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200words.
sample_essay:
In the dynamic landscape of the modern market, building trust between businesses and consumers is of paramount importance. To begin with, trust serves as the cornerstone of a long-term business-consumer relationship. When consumers trust a business, they are more likely to become repeat customers. For instance, Apple has built a strong reputation for quality and reliability, which has earned the trust of millions of consumers worldwide. As a result, many Apple users keep coming back to purchase new products.

In addition, trust can enhance a company's brand image. A business that is trusted by consumers is seen as more credible and reliable. Take Johnson & Johnson as an example. When it faced a product-tampering crisis, it took immediate and responsible actions, which helped it maintain the trust of consumers and safeguard its brand image.

Furthermore, trust can lead to positive word-of-mouth. Satisfied and trusting consumers are likely to recommend a business to their friends and family. This kind of free promotion can significantly expand a business's customer base.

In conclusion, building trust between business and consumers is not only beneficial for consumers to have a reliable shopping experience but also crucial for businesses to achieve long-term success and growth in the competitive market.
